Chat.disclaimer: AI-generated responses may contain errors. Not a substitute for theology or pastoral counsel.
Chat.loadingWarmup: I'm warming up. Be patient a moment...
Chat.backendWarmingUp: Server is waking up, you can start typing...
Chat.errorColdStart: I'm still warming up and it's taking longer than expected. Please try again in a moment - I'll be ready soon!
Chat.errorConnection: I'm sorry, I'm having trouble connecting right now. This could be a temporary issue - please try again in a moment. If the problem persists, you can reach us at contact@voxquieta.org
Chat.sessionLimitMessage: You've had 10 messages in this session! Why not take a moment to reflect on what you've received, step outside and enjoy God's creation? 🌳 When you're ready, start a new session below.

Verses.noVersesReferencedHint: Verses will appear here when mentioned in the chat.
